How to read ✕

The cards

Each monitored loopCounted once, from its newest 12h result (24h when chosen), at most 60 min old. In auto modeAUTO / CASCADE ≥ 95 % of the window. Saturated / at limitOP fully open or closed > 10 % of the window. FindingsSuspected or confirmed.

Loops requiring review

OrderPriority (loop criticality × finding severity), then time outside the good-error band, then how long the condition has persisted, then evidence score. Shelved loopsLeft out; listed in Loop Events.

The trend

Shaded bandThe lowest-to-highest PV inside each plotted point. Each point averages many samples; the band shows the swing the average hides.
